description.zh: 需要更新的云消息队列 Kafka 版的配置。配置信息必须是一个合法的JSON字符串。
description.en: The configuration of ApsaraMQ for Kafka that needs to be updated. The configuration information must be a valid JSON string.
The region ID of the instance.

descriptions.zh:
## **权限说明**
RAM用户需要先获取授权，才能调用**UpdateInstanceConfig**接口。授权的详细信息，请参见[RAM权限策略](~~185815~~)。
| API         | Action           | Resource|
| ------------- |------------   | ----- |
|UpdateInstanceConfig|alikafka: UpdateInstance|acs:alikafka:*:*:{instanceId}|
descriptions.en:
## **Permission information**

RAM users must obtain authorization before they can call the **UpdateInstanceConfig** operation. For more information, see [RAM access policies](~~185815~~).

| API                  | Action                   | Resource                      |
| -------------------- | ------------------------ | ----------------------------- |
| UpdateInstanceConfig | alikafka: UpdateInstance | acs:alikafka:*:*:{instanceId} |
